scripts.kill-ports: lsof -tiTCP:5001 -sTCP:LISTEN | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true; lsof -tiTCP:5173 -sTCP:LISTEN | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true; lsof -tiTCP:5174 -sTCP:LISTEN | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true; lsof -tiTCP:5175 -sTCP:LISTEN | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.dev: npm run kill-ports && concurrently "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
